settings.label: The Ingredient Directory
settings.title:
No secrets.
Science, simplified.
settings.text: Every active, every functional ingredient, and exactly why it's there. Clinical concentrations, total transparency — no marketing names, no hidden complexes.

settings.name: Alpha-Arbutin
settings.desc: Blocks melanin production at the source — not by stripping pigment, but by stopping new dark spots from forming. Clinically validated for PIH on South Asian skin tones.
settings.why_text: EU-validated as the exact efficacy threshold without irritation. Not rounded up, not cut down.

settings.name: Triple Ceramide Complex
settings.inci: CERAMIDE NP · CERAMIDE AP · CERAMIDE EOP
settings.desc: Your skin barrier is 50% ceramides, 25% cholesterol, 25% fatty acids. Lahore summers strip it. One ceramide type leaves gaps. All three, plus cholesterol and phytosphingosine, rebuild it properly.
settings.why_text: Your skin contains NP, AP, and EOP in specific proportions. One type alone is like patching a wall with one kind of brick.

settings.name: 6-Filter UV System
settings.inci: TINOSORB M · MEXORYL SX · AVOBENZONE · OCTINOXATE · OCTISALATE · ENSULIZOLE
settings.desc: No single UV filter covers 280nm–400nm. Six filters working together leave zero gaps — zero white cast, matte finish that holds in Pakistani humidity.
settings.why_text: Pakistan's UV index hits 10–12 in summer. Most SPFs here were tested at the European standard of 4. That's not the same protection.

settings.label: Hero Ingredients
settings.title:
Three ingredients.
Everything built around them.
settings.text: Each product is built around one star active — chosen for clinical evidence, not trends. Here's what they are and why we chose them.

settings.name: Niacinamide
settings.short_fn: Minimises pores, evens skin tone, and strengthens the barrier.
settings.desc: In every single Glowve product. Niacinamide is a powerhouse vitamin that manages oil, calms redness, and improves uneven skin tone.
settings.why: It is one of the most researched and stable ingredients in modern skincare.

settings.name: Sodium Hyaluronate
settings.short_fn: Penetrates deeper than standard HA to hydrate from within.
settings.desc: A smaller molecule weight of Hyaluronic Acid that can penetrate the top layer of skin and hold 1000x its weight in water.
settings.why: Topical hydration is temporary; internal hydration lasts.

settings.name: Tranexamic Acid
settings.short_fn: Blocks melanin transfer at a second pathway.
settings.desc: Works alongside Alpha-Arbutin for double the brightening effect without the irritation of retinoids.
settings.why: It targets the vascular component of dark spots, something other actives skip.

settings.name: Panthenol (B5)
settings.short_fn: Locks moisture in and accelerates skin healing.
settings.desc: Essential for barrier repair and serum comfort. A soothing humectant that also helps skin produce more lipids.
settings.why: Crucial for calming skin after UV exposure in hot climates.

settings.name: Zinc PCA
settings.desc: Keeps formula matte in Pakistani summer heat. Helps regulate oil production and inhibits certain bacteria.
settings.why: Standard Zinc can be drying; Zinc PCA is moisturising and calming.

settings.name: Licorice Root Extract
settings.desc: A gentler complement to the brightening actives. Contains liquiritin which helps disperse existing melanin.
settings.why: Nature's answer to brightening, safe for even the most sensitive skin.

settings.name: Allantoin
settings.short_fn: Speeds cell renewal and soothes redness.
settings.desc: Makes actives tolerable even for sensitive skin. An extract from the comfrey plant that promotes healing.
settings.why: Strong actives need a strong soothing partner to prevent irritation.

settings.name: Tocopherol (Vitamin E)
settings.desc: Amplifies the effect of other antioxidants. Specifically protects cell membranes from oxidative stress.
settings.why: Acts as the first line of defense against free radical damage from pollution.

settings.name: Matrixyl Peptides
settings.short_fn: Signal peptides that boost collagen production.
settings.desc: Helps maintain the structural integrity of the dermis. Works like a messenger to tell skin to fix itself.
settings.why: Topical collagen doesn't work; peptides tell your skin to make its own.

settings.label: Supporting Cast
settings.title:
Every ingredient
pulls its weight.
settings.text: No fillers, no padding. Every ingredient in our formulas has a functional reason to be there.

settings.name: Hydroquinone
settings.why: Common bleaching agent linked to ochronosis with long-term use. We use Alpha-Arbutin instead — no risk.

settings.name: Parabens
settings.why: Preservatives flagged for hormone disruption. We use cleaner phenoxyethanol complexes instead.

settings.name: Mineral Oil
settings.why: Cheap occlusive that does nothing for barrier repair. Our ceramide complex actually rebuilds it.

settings.name: Artificial Colorants
settings.why: No colour ingredient serves a function. If it doesn't do something, it doesn't go in.

settings.name: Bleaching Agents
settings.why: Mercury and unregulated depigmenting agents found in fairness creams. We brighten, we don't bleach.

settings.name: SLS / SLES
settings.why: Harsh surfactants that strip the skin barrier. Compromised skin gets worse with every wash.

settings.name: Phthalates
settings.why: Plasticiser chemicals with an endocrine disruption risk profile we're not comfortable with.

settings.name: Steroid / Corticosteroid
settings.why: Widely misused in Pakistani lightening creams. Clears skin while thinning it permanently. Never.
